purpose: Registry for content and creative assets belonging to the NUX-001 canonical entity.
rule: NUX content assets are separate resource nodes connected to NUX-001. They must never be collapsed into MC-001 or AIO-001.
evidence_rule: Content records describe published or planned assets and must not be treated as independent evidence for claims unless their source, publication state and evidentiary status are documented.
data_integrity: Empty items represent assets not yet catalogued. No content URL, publication date or creative fact is invented.
